purpose: Validation-only same-source TimeMixer baseline extension for frozen stride-24 relation-auxiliary MambaTSv3 on ETTh2 H96.
research_question: Does the fixed stride-24 AutoCon candidate remain competitive with a multi-scale TimeMixer baseline on the known ETTh2 transfer boundary without dataset-specific retuning?
evidence_boundary: Validation-only exploratory matrix. Every job skips the test loader; no test metric, prediction, streaming metric, or test release may be generated or inspected.
claim_boundary: This matrix supports only the named ETTh2 TimeMixer comparison and explicit boundary reporting. It cannot establish held-out accuracy, universal speed, independent AutoCon causality, or universal generalization.

required_before_launch: verify ETTh2 fingerprint and exact six-job expansion
freeze candidate, TimeMixer, optimizer, normalization, and seeds

selection_contract.freeze_rule: Candidate, TimeMixer, split, optimizer, scheduler, budget, normalization, and seeds are fixed before launch; no held-out signal or post-hoc retuning is allowed.

capacity_fairness_contract.common_public_budget: Both models share chronological split, M features, sequence length, horizon, optimizer, scheduler, batch size, epochs, patience, width, feed-forward dimension, and normalization.
capacity_fairness_contract.candidate_boundary: Only MambaTSv3AutoCon receives AutoCon lambda=.001 and stride-24 patching; prediction fusion remains disabled.
capacity_fairness_contract.baseline_boundary: TimeMixer receives no AutoCon, representation fusion, ACF memory, or candidate-only setting.

phases.name: stride24_candidate_timemixer_validation
phases.purpose: Frozen stride-24 MambaTSv3 relation-auxiliary-only candidate on ETTh2.

phases.name: timemixer_baseline_validation
phases.purpose: Same-source multiscale TimeMixer baseline on ETTh2.

comparison_contract.reporting_rule: Report every ETTh2 paired cell, including failures; do not infer AutoCon causality from candidate-versus-TimeMixer differences.

stopping_rules: Do not alter the frozen candidate or TimeMixer settings in response to this matrix.
Do not promote ETTh2 if candidate MSE is more than 2% above TimeMixer at H96.
Do not produce or inspect held-out artifacts.
prelaunch_gates: verify ETTh2 fingerprint and exact six-job expansion
